text: Accepted nsMsgAccountManager.OnFolderAdded guards all special-folder and parent-scope work with not Virtual. It asserts Panorama is disabled at startup, so this is a legacy route rather than a universal account-manager contract. Physical Inbox/Templates/Trash/Drafts/Junk and selected special descendants may become search sources; a saved search must not become another smart folder’s source in this path. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Legacy smart-folder scope excludes virtual folders before all classification work
